licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA) licence
licence.renewalDeadline: Expires at 12 midnight on the last day of the birth month in the second year of the two-year term (BPC 3523, as amended effective January 1, 2026)

ce.categoryRules: 50 hours of approved CME per two-year renewal period; approved programs are Category I (Preapproved) from AAPA, AMA, AOACCME, AAFP, ACCME or an ACCME-recognized state medical society

topicMandates.topic: Geriatric medicine, dementia care or care of older patients
topicMandates.hours: 20% of all mandatory CE hours (10 of 50 on the CME route; no hour figure stated for PAs who comply through NCCPA certification)
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs providing primary care to a population over 25% aged 65 or older (effective January 1, 2025)

topicMandates.topic: Schedule II controlled substances and risks of addiction
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs authorized in the practice agreement to furnish Schedule II, DEA registered, who did not complete the one-time course under 16 CCR 1399.610 and 1399.612

topicMandates.topic: Implicit bias (curriculum content inside every direct patient care course, not a separate hour count)
topicMandates.appliesTo: all CME courses with a direct patient care component (since January 1, 2022)

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: One-time Schedule II course (risks of addiction) as part of CE for PAs furnishing Schedule II who had not completed the 16 CCR 1399.610/1399.612 course

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written practice agreement signed by the PA and one or more physicians (or an authorized physician for an organized health care system); not approved or filed with the board; must state the method of periodic competence review and review of the agreement. Delegation of services agreements in effect before January 1, 2020 are deemed compliant.
practice.notes: PA furnishes drugs under physician supervision per the practice agreement; physician must be reachable by phone or electronic means when the PA examines the patient.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate state certificate; drug and device ordering (Schedule II to V as agreed) is authorized in the practice agreement. DEA-registered practitioners must apply for CURES (PDMP) access upon receiving DEA registration.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: One-time Schedule II course for PAs furnishing Schedule II who had not already completed it

facts.value: 50 hours of approved CME per two-year renewal period
facts.cite: 16 CCR § 1399.615 (as stated on PAB CME page)
facts.quote: is required to complete a minimum of fifty (50) hours of approved continuing medical education (CME) during each two (2) year renewal period.
facts.note: 16 CCR 1399.615 itself was not loaded (Cornell LII blocked); value taken from the PAB page, which is the board's own statement of the rule.

facts.value: Current NCCPA certification at renewal satisfies the CME requirement
facts.cite: PAB CME page; Bus. & Prof. Code § 3524.5(a)
facts.quote: certified by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA), or other qualified certifying body ... at the time of renewal are compliant

facts.value: Category I (Preapproved) from AAPA, AMA, AOACCME, AAFP, ACCME or ACCME-recognized state medical society
facts.cite: 16 CCR § 1399.616 (as stated on PAB CME page)
facts.quote: programs are approved by the Board for CME if they are designated as Category I (Preapproved) by one of the following sponsors

facts.value: Board may not require more than 50 hours every two years and shall accept NCCPA as appropriate
facts.quote: The board shall not require more than 50 hours of continuing education every two years.

facts.value: At least 20% of mandatory CE hours in geriatrics if over 25% of primary care patients are 65 or older
facts.quote: shall complete at least 20 percent of all mandatory continuing education hours in a course in the field of geriatric medicine

facts.value: CME courses with a direct patient care component must include implicit bias curriculum
facts.quote: all continuing education courses for licensees under this chapter contain curriculum that includes the understanding of implicit bias.

facts.value: Schedule II course as part of CE for PAs who had not completed the one-time 1399.610/1399.612 course
facts.quote: shall complete, as part of their continuing education requirements, a course that covers Schedule II controlled substances, and the risks of addiction

facts.value: Expires midnight last day of birth month in second year of two-year term
facts.cite: Bus. & Prof. Code 3523 (amended by AB 1501, effective January 1, 2026)
facts.quote: shall expire at 12 midnight of the last day of the birth month of the licensee during the second year of a two-year term

facts.value: Keep CME records 4 years
facts.quote: Physician assistants are required to retain records issued by an approved CME provider for a period of four (4) years.

facts.value: Practice agreement signed by PA and physician(s); board approval not required
facts.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to require approval of a practice agreement by the board.

facts.value: Agreement must state drugs, circumstances, extent of supervision, periodic competence review and review of the agreement
facts.quote: the method of periodic review of the PA's competence, including peer review, and review of the practice agreement.

facts.value: Practitioners authorized for Schedule II to V must apply for CURES access upon receiving DEA registration
facts.quote: shall, upon receipt of a federal Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) registration, submit an application developed by the department to obtain approval to electronically access

facts.value: Courses with no direct patient care component (research or similar) need not contain implicit bias content
facts.quote: a continuing education course dedicated solely to research or other issues that does not include a direct patient care component is not required

facts.value: A course meeting the 1399.610/1399.612 standards (as of June 7, 2019) satisfies the Schedule II course; no hour count stated
facts.quote: Evidence of completion of a course meeting the standards, including pharmacological content, established in Sections 1399.610 and 1399.612

rn.renewalDeadline: Every two years on or before the last day of the month following the birthday month

topicMandates.appliesTo: RNs within the first two years after initial licensure (otherwise exempt from CE on first renewal)

topicMandates.topic: Gerontology, dementia care or care of older patients
topicMandates.hours: 20% of all mandatory CE hours (6 of 30)
topicMandates.appliesTo: NPs providing primary care to a patient population over 25% aged 65 or older; certified at renewal

aprn.title: Nurse Practitioner (NP) certificate; NP Furnishing Number (NPF); 103 NP and 104 NP certifications for practice without standardized procedures
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: NP certification on the RN licence, plus a separate furnishing number for drug ordering; 103 NP / 104 NP certificates for practice without standardized procedures
aprn.ceHoursPerCycle: No separate NP hour count found; the 30 RN contact hours apply
aprn.nationalCertificationRequired: Not required for the standard NP certificate when the NP completed a BRN-approved program (national certification is the alternative route for out-of-state graduates); required for 103 NP and 104 NP

topicMandates.topic: Schedule II controlled substances (risks of addiction, legal requirements, patient-specific protocols)
topicMandates.period: by the time of renewal (board wording; whether every cycle or one-time is not stated)
topicMandates.appliesTo: NPs with a furnishing number authorized to furnish Schedule II and DEA registered

aprn.renewalNote: NP certificate and NP furnishing number renew at the same time as the RN licence, with additional fees
aprn.creditRuleFuture: From July 1, 2027: NPs whose patients are adult women under 65 earn 2 CE hours per hour of accredited perimenopause/menopause/postmenopause courses, capped at 6 hours (BPC 2811.5(j)(2), SB 164, 2026). A credit rule, not a mandate.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: BRN Nurse Practitioner Furnishing Number (requires pharmacology course); renewable with the RN licence; Schedule II designation added to the furnishing number
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: No recurring pharmacology hour requirement found beyond the Schedule II course
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: Minimum 3-hour Schedule II course by the time of renewal for NPs who furnish Schedule II

practice.agreementType: standardized procedures/protocols with physician supervision (physician may supervise no more than four NPs for furnishing); 103 NP and 104 NP pathways remove standardized procedures
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Standardized procedure or protocol developed and approved by the supervising physician, the NP and the facility administrator; must specify method of periodic competence review and review of the standardized procedure; not filed with the board. 103 NP: 3 full-time-equivalent years or 4,600 hours transition to practice; 104 NP: a further 3 years practice as an NP in good standing.

facts.value: 30 contact hours every two years
facts.cite: 16 CCR § 1451 (as stated on BRN CE page)
facts.quote: to complete 30 contact hours of continuing education every two years, in addition to paying the renewal fee, to maintain an active license.

facts.value: Biennial, by last day of month following birthday month
facts.quote: every two years on or before the last day of the month following the month in which their birthday occurs

facts.value: 1 hour implicit bias for licensees in first two years after initial licensure
facts.quote: those licensees shall complete one hour of direct participation in an implicit bias course

facts.value: 6 of 30 hours in gerontology for NPs whose primary care population is over 25% aged 65+
facts.cite: BRN CE page, Advanced Practice Certificates
facts.quote: at least 6 of the 30 continuing education hours required to renew their registered nurse license, in a course in the field of gerontology
facts.note: BRN page states 6 of 30; statute states 20 percent of mandatory hours (BPC 2811.5(j)(1)).

facts.value: Furnishing number issued by BRN; renewable at RN licence renewal
facts.quote: The number shall be renewable at the time of the applicant's registered nurse license renewal.

facts.value: Schedule II course as part of CE for furnishing NPs authorized for Schedule II with DEA registration
facts.quote: shall complete, as part of their continuing education requirements, a course including Schedule II controlled substances, and the risks of addiction

facts.value: Minimum 3-hour course by the time of renewal
facts.cite: BRN Advanced Practice Certification page (citing BPC 2836.1(g)(3))
facts.quote: nurse practitioners, by the time of renewal, complete a minimum 3-hour continuing education course that meets the Board requirements

facts.value: Standardized procedure or protocol approved by supervising physician, NP and facility administrator; max four NPs per physician for furnishing
facts.quote: no physician and surgeon shall supervise more than four nurse practitioners at one time.

facts.value: 103 NP: 3 full-time-equivalent years or 4,600 hours transition to practice; national certification required
facts.quote: Has completed a transition to practice in California of a minimum of three full-time equivalent years of practice or 4600 hours.

facts.value: 104 NP: additional 3 years practice in good standing beyond the transition to practice, plus master's or doctoral degree
facts.quote: Has practiced as a nurse practitioner in good standing for at least three years, not inclusive of the transition to practice

facts.value: National certification is the route for graduates of programs not approved by the BRN
facts.quote: If you did not complete a California Board-approved program, you will need to submit verification of national certification

facts.value: Not a member (secondary source only)
facts.quote: California is not a Nurse Licensure Compact state
facts.reason: No primary source states non-membership affirmatively. Supporting primary evidence: California NLC bills AB 410 (2021-22) and AB 3232 (2023-24) both show status Died on leginfo; no California NLC statute found.

facts.value: NPs with over 25% of primary care patients aged 65+ certify 20% of mandatory CE in gerontology, dementia or older patient care at renewal
facts.cite: Bus. & Prof. Code 2811.5(j)(1) (amended by SB 164, effective June 29, 2026)
facts.quote: shall certify that they have completed at least 20 percent of all existing mandatory continuing education hours in a course in the field of gerontology

facts.value: Board CE standards may not exceed 30 hours
facts.quote: shall not exceed 30 hours of direct participation in a course or courses approved by the board

facts.value: First renewal after passing NCLEX within two years is exempt from CE except the implicit bias hour
facts.cite: BRN Continuing Education page; Bus. & Prof. Code 2811.5(h)
facts.quote: this is your first renewal, you are exempt from the CE requirement, with the exception of the Implicit Bias requirement.

facts.value: NP and NP furnishing certificates renew with the RN licence; renewal fees due at the same time
facts.cite: BRN License/Certificate Renewal page, Advanced Practice Certificate Renewal
facts.quote: Renewal fees for the certificates listed above are due at the same time as your RN license renewal fee.

facts.value: 3-hour Schedule II course is required to retain Schedule II furnishing privileges, completed by the time of renewal
facts.quote: in order to retain privileges to furnish Schedule II substances, nurse practitioners, by the time of renewal, complete a minimum 3-hour

facts.value: 103 NP requires a current national NP certification from an NCCA or ABNS accredited body recognized by the board
facts.quote: Holds a certification as a nurse practitioner from a national certifying body accredited by the National Commission for Certifying Agencies

unverified: California not a Nurse Licensure Compact member: no primary source states it affirmatively; NLC bills AB 410 (2021-22) and AB 3232 (2023-24) both died (leginfo status pages loaded). Recorded false with verified:false.
16 CCR 1399.615, 1399.616 and 16 CCR 1451 were not loaded directly (Cornell LII returned a block page); content taken from the PAB and BRN pages, which are the boards' own statements.
State controlled substance registration for PA and NP: none found; only CURES access on DEA registration (HSC 11165.1) is confirmed. Left null.
NP Schedule II 3-hour course: BRN says 'in order to retain privileges... by the time of renewal'; whether every renewal or once is not stated in BPC 2836.1(g)(3) or the BRN page.
Whether continued national certification is checked at renewal of 103 NP / 104 NP certificates was not confirmed (2837.103 states it as a qualification).
PA Schedule II course hours: BPC 3502.1(e)(3) gives no hour figure; 16 CCR 1399.610/1399.612 standards not loaded.
PA geriatric 20% rule (BPC 3524.6) for PAs who comply through NCCPA certification: how the 20% is measured is not stated.
Practice authority label 'restricted' is our reading of BPC 2836.1 (standardized procedures, physician supervision, max four NPs per physician for furnishing) with the 103/104 NP exceptions.

corrections: pa.licence.renewalDeadline: removed 'no grace period'; neither BPC 3523 nor any PAB page loaded says that. Noted BPC 3523 was amended by AB 1501 effective January 1, 2026 (birth month rule unchanged).
PA geriatric mandate: hours expressed as 20% of mandatory hours (10 of 50 on the CME route); unclear for the NCCPA route.
NP gerontology: now cited to the statute BPC 2811.5(j)(1) (20 percent of mandatory hours, certified at renewal), amended by SB 164 effective June 29, 2026; BRN's '6 of 30' kept as the derived figure.
Added future credit rule: from July 1, 2027 NPs treating adult women under 65 earn double credit (up to 6 hours) for menopause courses (BPC 2811.5(j)(2)). Not a mandate.
Resolved: NP certificate and furnishing number renew with the RN licence (BRN renewal page), removed from unverified.
np.rn.nlcCompactMember: kept verified:false; added primary supporting evidence (AB 410 and AB 3232 died).

Added facts: implicit bias exception for non-patient-care courses (3524.5(c)); Schedule II course equivalence (3502.1(e)(3)); RN CE cap 30 hours (2811.5(c)); first renewal exemption except implicit bias; 103 NP national certification (2837.103(a)(1)(B)).

Missed-mandate sweep: the 12-hour one-time pain/end-of-life course (BPC 2190.5) is physician-only; BPC 2811.5(e)-(g) and 3524.5(e) only ask the boards to 'consider' spousal abuse, end of life, menopause and maternal mental health courses, so none is a mandate. No other PA or NP topic mandate found.
